tests.native_face: For each face, train on its two teaching surfaces per relation and classify the held-out surface.
tests.leave_one_face_out: For each face, train on all teaching surfaces from the other three faces and classify the held-out surface of the omitted face.

interpretation.native_face: Measures how much a simple surface learner can retain within a representational theater.
interpretation.leave_one_face_out: Measures whether surface similarity alone reconstructs relation identity across unseen theaters.
interpretation.pass_not_internalization: Even strong performance is only a comparator. It cannot establish semantic ownership because the relation labels are teacher supplied.
